curatedLibrary.enabledHint: When checked, this library's curated folders, playlists, and audio files start syncing to the cloud and stay live. Analysis, cues, filter/SET/mixtape libraries, and the recycle bin itself are not synced.

After that, local changes are pushed automatically and new cloud revisions are pulled automatically. Fingerprint sync and curated-library sync queue instead of running in parallel.

curatedLibrary.joinLocalHint: The cloud will match this computer. Current cloud content will be replaced.

curatedLibrary.overwriteConfirmHint: This cannot be undone automatically. Still replace the cloud with this computer?

reset.title: Dangerous: Clear cloud curated library
reset.description: This empties the cloud curated library for the current userKey (folders, playlists, and audio) and frees that quota. Every device with curated sync enabled follows the empty cloud immediately (no first-alignment prompt); local curated tracks go to the recycle bin. Cloud fingerprints and curated artists are not cleared. IRREVERSIBLE. Type DELETE to continue.
reset.hint: The cloud curated library becomes empty. All devices with sync on also clear their curated libraries into the recycle bin, without a first-alignment prompt. Cloud fingerprints and curated artists are left untouched.
reset.needUserKey: Save a userKey first, then try this action again.
reset.success: Cloud curated library cleared. Devices with sync on will match the empty cloud; curated tracks go to the recycle bin.
